TWG Tea opens largest global flagship at Changi Airport

By Irene Dong October 5, 2026
20
Listen to audio version of this article
Sponsored by
0:00 / 1:44
Instaread

TWG Tea has unveiled its largest global flagship at Singapore Changi Airport Terminal 3, introducing a new luxury travel retail concept that combines retail, heritage and F&B experiences.

The 2700sqft TWG Tea Gallery features the brand’s first-ever TWG Tea Museum, alongside its Tea Boutique, bespoke gifting, tea accessories and a takeaway concept designed for travellers.

The museum features more than 170 antique tea wares and decorative objects, as well as more than 50 Russian samovars dating from the 17th to 20th centuries. The collection includes Yixing clay teapots, Chinese and Western ceramics, with pieces collected by TWG Tea over the past 15 years.

The store’s design includes a hand-painted ceiling featuring a map of the world’s tea-producing regions, extending the museum’s focus on tea’s global history into the wider retail space.

“More than a Tea Boutique, the flagship brings the past, present and future of tea into one immersive experience, celebrating the stories, traditions and artistry that have shaped tea over the centuries, brought to life through its landmark TWG Tea Museum,” said Taha Bouqdib, president & CEO of V3 Gourmet and co-founder of TWG Tea. 

“Singapore has remained central to TWG Tea since its founding, and we are honoured to present our largest global flagship at Changi Airport, an icon of aviation excellence and an extraordinary platform to bring the world of TWG Tea to travellers from around the world.”

In addition, the retail space is anchored by a wall displaying more than 1200 tea tins. 

The opening comes as TWG Tea continues to build its presence in travel retail, with Changi providing a high-volume international setting for the Singapore-founded brand.

  • Further reading: TWG Tea unveils new concept store at Hong Kong’s IFC Mall.
